# Abyss Fruits & Will

[Home](README.md) · [Getting started](getting-started.md) · [Magic](magic.md) · [Abyss Fruits](fruits.md) · [Companions](companions.md) · [AI & simulation](ai-and-simulation.md) · [World events](world-events.md) · [Mobs & bosses](mobs-and-bosses.md) · [Items & recipes](items-and-recipes.md) · [Progression](progression.md) · [Commands](commands.md) · [FAQ](faq.md) · [Development](development.md)

---

Eat an **Abyss Fruit** (hold Use) to gain its power for good, plus a bound **power item**: hold it and **Use** to cast the selected ability, **Sneak + Use** to switch abilities. Beast fruits show their animal form while you hold the power.

* **One fruit only.** Eating a second fruit hurts you badly (14 damage, nausea, wither) and does nothing else.
* **The sea rejects you.** With your head under water your powers stop working, you are slowed, weakened and slowly sink.
* **Anti-magic seals you.** Demon-sword hits and anti-magic slashes switch your powers off for a few seconds.
* **It stays with you.** The power item comes back after you die.
* **Where to get fruits:** Raider Captains (35% drop - they wield their fruit in battle), sunken-wreck chests, the Abyssal Leviathan (guaranteed), sky-treasure chests (15%), the Bounty Board (400 doubloons) and the Travelling Merchant (450 doubloons).

## Will

Everyone has **Will**, a fighting-spirit stat trained by fighting (melee hits, taking hits, kills, bounties, Leviathan Scales). Will levels go up to **10** (level *n* needs 25 + 20·*n* Will XP); the Will gauge refills over time.

| Will level | Unlock |
|---|---|
| 1 | **Iron Will** - melee hits spend Will for 2 + level bonus damage |
| 3 | **Keen Will** - a 5% + 2% per level chance (+10% with the Quicksilver Fruit) to sidestep a hit; the damage is undone |
| 8 | **Sovereign Will** - Sneak + Jump at full Will: a pulse that floors weak enemies and staggers the rest |
